content.question: How does FP-Growth differ from Apriori?
options: It uses a vertical data format and intersects transaction ID lists.
It evaluates rules using confidence and lift, unlike Apriori.
It generates more candidate itemsets through extra passes over the data.
Instead of generating candidate itemsets through multiple passes over the data, it uses a divide-and-conquer strategy and a frequent-pattern tree structure.
content.answer: Instead of generating candidate itemsets through multiple passes over the data, it uses a divide-and-conquer strategy and a frequent-pattern tree structure.
